description: This PHP class 'Key' encapsulates a cryptographic key string, providing mechanisms to securely handle it, including zeroing out memory upon destruction, and exposing methods to retrieve the key and its length.

classes.name: Key
classes.description: A class designed to securely wrap and handle cryptographic keys, hiding their representation from stack traces and attempting to zero out the key in memory upon object destruction.

methods.name: __debugInfo
methods.description: Returns an empty array to hide internal data from debug output.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new Key object with the provided string.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Attempts to securely zero out the internal string memory using sodium_memzero if available; otherwise, XORs the string with itself as a fallback.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the stored cryptographic key string.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Returns the length of the key string, using mb_strlen if available for multibyte support, otherwise falls back to strlen.

search-terms: PHP class for secure key handling
